(program "github.com/synodlang/examples/cassandra#main"
  (packages "std/disk" "std/lists" "std/net" "std/random" "std/time" "github.com/synodlang/examples/gossip" "std/maps" "std/math" "std/sim" "std/text" "github.com/synodlang/examples/ring" "github.com/synodlang/examples/cassandra" "std/lesson" "github.com/synodlang/examples/cassandra#main")
  (main "main"
    (vars (0 nodes local list of cassandra.Node) (1 i each number) (2 n each cassandra.Node) (3 replicas local list of node) (4 coordinator local node) (5 victim local node))
    (body
      (native "sim.seed" 4)
      (set nodes#0 (native "sim.cluster" 6 (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/cassandra")))
      (each i#1 n#2 nodes#0
        (if (more-than i#1 0)
          (then
            (call "gossip.Join … to" n#2 (item nodes#0 0)))))
      (set replicas#3 (call "ring.Owners of … among … count" "user:42" nodes#0 3))
      (set coordinator#4 (item replicas#3 0))
      (set victim#5 (item replicas#3 1))
      (after (time 5000000)
        (deliver (message cassandra.Write (Key "user:42") (Value "Ada")) coordinator#4))
      (after (time 6000000)
        (native "sim.crash" victim#5))
      (after (time 12000000)
        (deliver (message cassandra.Write (Key "user:42") (Value "Grace")) coordinator#4)
        (call "lesson.Ask" "One replica is down. Does the write succeed, and how will that replica catch up?"))
      (after (time 14000000)
        (deliver (message cassandra.Read (Key "user:42")) (item replicas#3 2)))
      (after (time 18000000)
        (native "sim.restart" victim#5)
        (call "lesson.Note" "Data lives in memory here, so the restarted replica is refilled only by hints."))
      (native "sim.stopAt" (time 30000000))))
  (package "std/disk" std
    (runs "std/disk"))
  (package "std/lists" std
    (runs "std/lists"))
  (package "std/net" std
    (runs "std/net"))
  (package "std/random" std
    (runs "std/random"))
  (package "std/time" std
    (runs "std/time")
    (phrase "Every"
      (vars (0 d param time) (1 b block))
      (body
        (run-block b#1)
        (after d#0
          (call "time.Every" d#0
            (block
              (run-block b#1)))))))
  (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/gossip"
    (uses "std/disk" "std/lists" "std/net" "std/random" "std/time")
    (runs "std/disk" "std/lists" "std/net" "std/random" "std/time" "github.com/synodlang/examples/gossip")
    (node-fields
      (field Generation number exported 0)
      (field Heartbeat number exported 0)
      (field Known map of node to number exported (empty map of node to number))
      (field Down list of node exported (empty list of node))
      (field peers list of node (empty list of node))
      (field seenAt map of node to time (empty map of node to time)))
    (record digest
      (field known map of node to number (empty map of node to number)))
    (start "start"
      (vars (0 n receiver gossip.Node))
      (body
        (set-field n#0 gossip.Generation (plus (native "disk.read" "generation" n#0 0) 1))
        (native "disk.write" (nodefield n#0 gossip.Generation) "generation" n#0)
        (call "time.Every" (time 1000000)
          (block
            (set-field n#0 gossip.Heartbeat (plus (nodefield n#0 gossip.Heartbeat) 1))
            (call "gossip.Learn … at" (recv n#0) n#0 (call "gossip.Version" (recv n#0)))
            (call "gossip.CheckPeers" (recv n#0))
            (if (more-than (native "lists.size" (nodefield n#0 gossip.peers)) 0)
              (then
                (native "net.send" (message gossip.digest (known (nodefield n#0 gossip.Known))) n#0 (native "random.pick" (nodefield n#0 gossip.peers)))))))))
    (phrase "Join … to"
      (vars (0 n param gossip.Node) (1 seed param node))
      (body
        (set-field n#0 gossip.peers (list seed#1))))
    (phrase "Version" (result number)
      (vars (0 n receiver gossip.Node))
      (body
        (result (plus (times (nodefield n#0 gossip.Generation) 1000000) (nodefield n#0 gossip.Heartbeat)))))
    (phrase "Learn … at"
      (vars (0 n receiver gossip.Node) (1 k param node) (2 v param number))
      (body
        (set-item (nodefield n#0 gossip.Known) k#1 v#2 map)
        (set-item (nodefield n#0 gossip.seenAt) k#1 (native "time.now") map)
        (if (and (is-not k#1 n#0) (not-in k#1 (nodefield n#0 gossip.peers)))
          (then
            (set-field n#0 gossip.peers (native "lists.append" k#1 (nodefield n#0 gossip.peers)))))))
    (phrase "CheckPeers"
      (vars (0 n receiver gossip.Node) (1 suspects local list of node) (2 k each node) (3 t each time))
      (body
        (set suspects#1 (empty list of node))
        (each k#2 t#3 (nodefield n#0 gossip.seenAt) map
          (if (more-than (minus:time (native "time.now") t#3) (time 4000000))
            (then
              (set suspects#1 (native "lists.append" k#2 suspects#1)))))
        (set-field n#0 gossip.Down suspects#1)))
    (when-node "net.received"
      (vars (0 n receiver gossip.Node) (1 digest binding gossip.digest) (2 sender binding node) (3 k each node) (4 v each number))
      (match 0 record gossip.digest digest#1)
      (match 1 bind sender#2)
      (body
        (each k#3 v#4 (recfield digest#1 known) map
          (if (in k#3 (nodefield n#0 gossip.Known) map)
            (then
              (if (more-than v#4 (item (nodefield n#0 gossip.Known) k#3 map))
                (then
                  (call "gossip.Learn … at" (recv n#0) k#3 v#4))))
            (else
              (call "gossip.Learn … at" (recv n#0) k#3 v#4))))
        (if (not-in sender#2 (nodefield n#0 gossip.peers))
          (then
            (set-field n#0 gossip.peers (native "lists.append" sender#2 (nodefield n#0 gossip.peers))))))))
  (package "std/maps" std
    (runs "std/maps"))
  (package "std/math" std
    (runs "std/math"))
  (package "std/sim" std
    (runs "std/sim"))
  (package "std/text" std
    (runs "std/text"))
  (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/ring"
    (uses "std/lists" "std/maps" "std/math" "std/sim" "std/text")
    (runs "std/lists" "std/maps" "std/math" "std/sim" "std/text" "github.com/synodlang/examples/ring")
    (record Placed exported
      (field Key text exported "")
      (field Owner node exported (native "sim.nobody")))
    (phrase "Vnodes" (result number)
      (vars)
      (body
        (result 8)))
    (phrase "TokensOf" (result list of number)
      (vars (0 n param node) (1 tokens local list of number) (2 i each number))
      (body
        (set tokens#1 (empty list of number))
        (each _ i#2 (native "lists.range" 1 (call "ring.Vnodes"))
          (set tokens#1 (native "lists.append" (native "math.hash" (native "text.join" (list (native "sim.name" n#0) "#" (native "text.from" i#2)))) tokens#1)))
        (result tokens#1)))
    (phrase "Distance from … to" (result number)
      (vars (0 h param number) (1 n param node) (2 best local number) (3 t each number) (4 d local number))
      (body
        (set best#2 1)
        (each _ t#3 (call "ring.TokensOf" n#1)
          (set d#4 (native "math.remainder" (minus t#3 h#0) 1))
          (if (less-than d#4 best#2)
            (then
              (set best#2 d#4))))
        (result best#2)))
    (phrase "Owners of … among … count" (result list of node)
      (vars (0 k param text) (1 ns param list of node) (2 r param number) (3 h local number) (4 distances local map of node to number) (5 n each node))
      (body
        (set h#3 (native "math.hash" k#0))
        (set distances#4 (empty map of node to number))
        (each _ n#5 ns#1
          (set-item distances#4 n#5 (call "ring.Distance from … to" h#3 n#5) map))
        (result (native "lists.take" r#2 (native "maps.keysByValue" distances#4))))))
  (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/cassandra"
    (uses "github.com/synodlang/examples/gossip" "github.com/synodlang/examples/ring" "std/lists" "std/maps" "std/net" "std/sim" "std/text" "std/time")
    (runs "std/disk" "std/lists" "std/net" "std/random" "std/time" "github.com/synodlang/examples/gossip" "std/maps" "std/math" "std/sim" "std/text" "github.com/synodlang/examples/ring" "github.com/synodlang/examples/cassandra")
    (node-fields
      (field Data map of text to text exported (empty map of text to text))
      (field PendingHints number exported 0)
      (field versions map of text to time (empty map of text to time))
      (field hints list of cassandra.Hint (empty list of cassandra.Hint))
      (field nextRequest number 0)
      (field acks map of text to number (empty map of text to number))
      (field keys map of text to text (empty map of text to text))
      (field replies map of text to list of cassandra.FetchReply (empty map of text to list of cassandra.FetchReply)))
    (record Write exported
      (field Key text exported "")
      (field Value text exported ""))
    (record Read exported
      (field Key text exported ""))
    (record Written exported
      (field Key text exported "")
      (field Acks number exported 0))
    (record ReadDone exported
      (field Key text exported "")
      (field Value text exported ""))
    (record Mutation exported
      (field key text "")
      (field value text "")
      (field stamp time (time 0))
      (field request text ""))
    (record MutationAck exported
      (field request text ""))
    (record Fetch exported
      (field key text "")
      (field request text ""))
    (record FetchReply exported
      (field request text "")
      (field value text "")
      (field stamp time (time 0)))
    (record Hint exported
      (field target node (native "sim.nobody"))
      (field mutation cassandra.Mutation (message cassandra.Mutation (key ""))))
    (start "start"
      (vars (0 n receiver cassandra.Node) (1 waiting local list of cassandra.Hint) (2 h each cassandra.Hint))
      (body
        (call "time.Every" (time 1000000)
          (block
            (set waiting#1 (empty list of cassandra.Hint))
            (each _ h#2 (nodefield n#0 cassandra.hints)
              (if (in (recfield h#2 target) (nodefield n#0 gossip.Down))
                (then
                  (set waiting#1 (native "lists.append" h#2 waiting#1)))
                (else
                  (native "net.send" (recfield h#2 mutation) n#0 (recfield h#2 target)))))
            (set-field n#0 cassandra.hints waiting#1)
            (set-field n#0 cassandra.PendingHints (native "lists.size" (nodefield n#0 cassandra.hints)))))))
    (phrase "Factor" (result number)
      (vars)
      (body
        (result 3)))
    (phrase "Quorum" (result number)
      (vars)
      (body
        (result 2)))
    (phrase "Members" (result list of node)
      (vars (0 n receiver cassandra.Node))
      (body
        (result (native "maps.keys" (nodefield n#0 gossip.Known)))))
    (phrase "ReplicasOf" (result list of node)
      (vars (0 n receiver cassandra.Node) (1 k param text))
      (body
        (result (call "ring.Owners of … among … count" k#1 (call "cassandra.Members" (recv n#0)) (call "cassandra.Factor")))))
    (phrase "NewRequest" (result text)
      (vars (0 n receiver cassandra.Node) (1 k param text) (2 id local text))
      (body
        (set-field n#0 cassandra.nextRequest (plus (nodefield n#0 cassandra.nextRequest) 1))
        (set id#2 (native "text.from" (nodefield n#0 cassandra.nextRequest)))
        (set-item (nodefield n#0 cassandra.keys) id#2 k#1 map)
        (result id#2)))
    (phrase "Store"
      (vars (0 n receiver cassandra.Node) (1 m param cassandra.Mutation))
      (body
        (set-item (nodefield n#0 cassandra.Data) (recfield m#1 key) (recfield m#1 value) map)
        (set-item (nodefield n#0 cassandra.versions) (recfield m#1 key) (recfield m#1 stamp) map)))
    (phrase "Apply"
      (vars (0 n receiver cassandra.Node) (1 m param cassandra.Mutation) (2 k local text))
      (body
        (set k#2 (recfield m#1 key))
        (if (in k#2 (nodefield n#0 cassandra.versions) map)
          (then
            (if (more-than (recfield m#1 stamp) (item (nodefield n#0 cassandra.versions) k#2 map))
              (then
                (call "cassandra.Store" (recv n#0) m#1))))
          (else
            (call "cassandra.Store" (recv n#0) m#1)))))
    (when-node "sim.delivered"
      (vars (0 n receiver cassandra.Node) (1 Write binding cassandra.Write) (2 id local text) (3 m local cassandra.Mutation) (4 r each node))
      (match 0 record cassandra.Write Write#1)
      (body
        (set id#2 (call "cassandra.NewRequest" (recv n#0) (recfield Write#1 Key)))
        (set-item (nodefield n#0 cassandra.acks) id#2 0 map)
        (set m#3 (message cassandra.Mutation (key (recfield Write#1 Key)) (value (recfield Write#1 Value)) (stamp (native "time.now")) (request id#2)))
        (each _ r#4 (call "cassandra.ReplicasOf" (recv n#0) (recfield Write#1 Key))
          (if (in r#4 (nodefield n#0 gossip.Down))
            (then
              (set-field n#0 cassandra.hints (native "lists.append" (message cassandra.Hint (target r#4) (mutation m#3)) (nodefield n#0 cassandra.hints)))
              (set-field n#0 cassandra.PendingHints (native "lists.size" (nodefield n#0 cassandra.hints))))
            (else
              (native "net.send" m#3 n#0 r#4))))))
    (when-node "net.received"
      (vars (0 n receiver cassandra.Node) (1 Mutation binding cassandra.Mutation) (2 coordinator binding node))
      (match 0 record cassandra.Mutation Mutation#1)
      (match 1 bind coordinator#2)
      (body
        (call "cassandra.Apply" (recv n#0) Mutation#1)
        (native "net.send" (message cassandra.MutationAck (request (recfield Mutation#1 request))) n#0 coordinator#2)))
    (when-node "net.received"
      (vars (0 n receiver cassandra.Node) (1 MutationAck binding cassandra.MutationAck) (2 replica binding node) (3 id local text))
      (match 0 record cassandra.MutationAck MutationAck#1)
      (match 1 bind replica#2)
      (body
        (set id#3 (recfield MutationAck#1 request))
        (set-item (nodefield n#0 cassandra.acks) id#3 (plus (item (nodefield n#0 cassandra.acks) id#3 map) 1) map)
        (if (is (item (nodefield n#0 cassandra.acks) id#3 map) (call "cassandra.Quorum"))
          (then
            (emit (message cassandra.Written (Key (item (nodefield n#0 cassandra.keys) id#3 map)) (Acks (call "cassandra.Quorum"))) n#0)))))
    (when-node "sim.delivered"
      (vars (0 n receiver cassandra.Node) (1 Read binding cassandra.Read) (2 id local text) (3 r each node))
      (match 0 record cassandra.Read Read#1)
      (body
        (set id#2 (call "cassandra.NewRequest" (recv n#0) (recfield Read#1 Key)))
        (set-item (nodefield n#0 cassandra.replies) id#2 (empty list of cassandra.FetchReply) map)
        (each _ r#3 (call "cassandra.ReplicasOf" (recv n#0) (recfield Read#1 Key))
          (if (not-in r#3 (nodefield n#0 gossip.Down))
            (then
              (native "net.send" (message cassandra.Fetch (key (recfield Read#1 Key)) (request id#2)) n#0 r#3))))))
    (when-node "net.received"
      (vars (0 n receiver cassandra.Node) (1 Fetch binding cassandra.Fetch) (2 coordinator binding node) (3 k local text))
      (match 0 record cassandra.Fetch Fetch#1)
      (match 1 bind coordinator#2)
      (body
        (set k#3 (recfield Fetch#1 key))
        (if (in k#3 (nodefield n#0 cassandra.Data) map)
          (then
            (native "net.send" (message cassandra.FetchReply (request (recfield Fetch#1 request)) (value (item (nodefield n#0 cassandra.Data) k#3 map)) (stamp (item (nodefield n#0 cassandra.versions) k#3 map))) n#0 coordinator#2))
          (else
            (native "net.send" (message cassandra.FetchReply (request (recfield Fetch#1 request))) n#0 coordinator#2)))))
    (when-node "net.received"
      (vars (0 n receiver cassandra.Node) (1 FetchReply binding cassandra.FetchReply) (2 replica binding node) (3 id local text) (4 best local cassandra.FetchReply) (5 r each cassandra.FetchReply))
      (match 0 record cassandra.FetchReply FetchReply#1)
      (match 1 bind replica#2)
      (body
        (set id#3 (recfield FetchReply#1 request))
        (set-item (nodefield n#0 cassandra.replies) id#3 (native "lists.append" FetchReply#1 (item (nodefield n#0 cassandra.replies) id#3 map)) map)
        (if (is (native "lists.size" (item (nodefield n#0 cassandra.replies) id#3 map)) (call "cassandra.Quorum"))
          (then
            (set best#4 (item (item (nodefield n#0 cassandra.replies) id#3 map) 0))
            (each _ r#5 (item (nodefield n#0 cassandra.replies) id#3 map)
              (if (more-than (recfield r#5 stamp) (recfield best#4 stamp))
                (then
                  (set best#4 r#5))))
            (emit (message cassandra.ReadDone (Key (item (nodefield n#0 cassandra.keys) id#3 map)) (Value (recfield best#4 value))) n#0))))))
  (package "std/lesson" std
    (uses "std/sim")
    (runs "std/sim" "std/lesson")
    (record Asked exported
      (field Question text exported ""))
    (record Noted exported
      (field Text text exported ""))
    (phrase "Ask"
      (vars (0 q param text))
      (body
        (emit (message lesson.Asked (Question q#0)) (native "sim.nobody"))))
    (phrase "Note"
      (vars (0 t param text))
      (body
        (emit (message lesson.Noted (Text t#0)) (native "sim.nobody")))))
  (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/cassandra#main" main
    (uses "github.com/synodlang/examples/cassandra" "github.com/synodlang/examples/gossip" "github.com/synodlang/examples/ring" "std/lesson" "std/sim")
    (runs "std/disk" "std/lists" "std/net" "std/random" "std/time" "github.com/synodlang/examples/gossip" "std/maps" "std/math" "std/sim" "std/text" "github.com/synodlang/examples/ring" "github.com/synodlang/examples/cassandra" "std/lesson" "github.com/synodlang/examples/cassandra#main")))
